name: dsfd_vm_xio_return_native_1016_r3

pin_regs.reason: Actual source first-stage input return captures, issue/output pin registers; component exact fixed-edge differential gate plus six observed mutants.

structural_change: r3 (S-VM-XRET 10-16): (1) RTL: e_v / return_valid / f_xgo get plain pin capture flops (ev_raw / valid_raw / xq_raw <= pin); the rn qualification is applied after the flop from a registered rn copy (rq[2]): rn_d ? raw : 0 equals the former rn ? pin : 0 captured at the same edge -- zero cycle change, proved by tools/s81_vm/xio_return_r3_equiv_gate.sh (r3 vs frozen r2, every output every cycle, random inputs through 400 async resets x 4 seeds; mutant RNQ fails). r2 mapped ev_pin<=rn?e_v:0 to AND2 + SDFF; io_flop_at_pins walks INV/BUF only, so the four e_v flops were never anchored and sat at x=162-164 um, 162 um from their W pins (BUFx16f wire buffer + BUFx2): e_v[0] TT setup -47.3 ps + R 267.3 = capture 220.0 > 190. (2) Outline right-sized by pin perimeter 216x324 -> 75.6x280.8 (fill 0.062 -> ~0.2-0.3). Static fixed-cycle; no backpressure, no clock relaxation.
